subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram partial-stream finalization lacks clear delivery-mode observability (sent vs preview-finalized vs canceled)

question: Should maintainers require the linked Telegram PR to be rebased with live proof, replace it from current main, or fold this issue into the broader durable final-delivery contract before closing?
rationale: The issue is source-reproducible and production-backed, but the direct candidate PR is currently conflicting and lacks real Telegram proof, while adjacent issues cover broader hook and durable-final semantics.

options.title: Rebase And Prove The Linked PR
options.body: Resolve the current conflict, preserve delayed delivered-state semantics, add or retain focused tests, and attach redacted after-fix Telegram proof before closing this issue.

options.title: Replace From Current Main
options.body: If the stale branch is too costly to reconcile, open a narrow current-main replacement and close the linked PR only after the replacement exists.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Contract
options.body: If maintainers want one cross-channel delivery outcome contract first, explicitly link this issue under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561 and retire the Telegram-specific branch.

recommendation.title: Rebase And Prove The Linked PR
recommendation.body: Resolve the current conflict, preserve delayed delivered-state semantics, add or retain focused tests, and attach redacted after-fix Telegram proof before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Telegram lane-delivery repair history and shared delivery ownership make this the best available routing candidate for the proof and replacement decision.
